page: Amazon Web Services m8ine.xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor and Intel x86_64 processor architecture. The hardware configuration provides 4 vCPUs mapped across 2 dedicated physical cores with simultaneous multithreading at 2 threads per core, operating at a clock frequency of 3.9 GHz. System memory totals 16.0 GB, establishing a standard balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual processor.

Networking and storage interfaces are optimized through the underlying Nitro platform. The instance delivers a baseline network throughput of 6 Gbps and provides no complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Local physical disk storage is not bundled, necessitating the use of remote network-attached block volumes for persistence. Furthermore, the instance does not feature GPU accelerators, directing all host resources toward standard CPU and memory operations.

With its 1:4 core-to-memory ratio, the configuration is cost-efficient for horizontal scaling where large local scratch disks are unnecessary. Because storage performance depends on remote block devices, disk-heavy workloads must account for network volume limits. The instance is structured for intermediate workloads such as microservices, backend web servers, container orchestration nodes, and continuous integration tasks.
description: Amazon Web Services m8ine.xlarge is an eighth-generation general-purpose cloud instance built on the Nitro hypervisor platform. Running on the x86_64 architecture, the instance is powered by dedicated Intel processors clocked at 3.9 GHz, providing 4 vCPUs across 2 physical cores with 2 threads per core. System memory is configured at 16.0 GB, maintaining a balanced 4.0 GB per vCPU distribution suitable for diverse business applications. The instance contains no integrated GPUs and includes no local disk storage, relying on networked block storage for all filesystem persistence. Network connectivity provides a baseline speed of 6 Gbps. Given its standard resource balance and dedicated compute allocation, m8ine.xlarge offers solid cost efficiency for general-purpose workloads, including application middleware, containerized services, backend web hosting, and build automation pipelines.
